rationale: Both blocking findings from the final round are resolved by commit 312e15330. CR-001: SettingsForm.tsx now keys both <CredentialFields key={credentialType} .../> usages, forcing the whole field subtree (including MultiSelectCheckboxGroup's local 'blocked' state) to remount on every credential-type switch — this is the correct root-cause fix, since it clears the stale flag even in the case where the underlying react-hook-form value bounces back to an identical string after reset() (confirmed via a new regression test that exercises exactly that scenario, not just a naive value-diff). CR-002: emptySelectionError is now a configurable field on CredentialFieldConfig, threaded through the extracted MultiSelectCheckboxGroup component with a generic default message; settingsUIConfig.ts sets the GitLab-specific wording explicitly for gitlab_event_filter (verified by a new test confirming an unrelated multiselect field gets the generic fallback, not GitLab wording). The fix-up diff is small and scoped to React state/prop wiring with no security, auth, public-API, or data-loss surface, so no confirmation pass was run. 10 tests total (8 in the CredentialFields suite plus 2 new regression tests), tsc and eslint clean.

business_review.criterion: AC1 — Users can define specific merge request event actions (Created, Updated, Closed, Reopened, Merged, Approved/Unapproved) in the webhook integration settings
business_review.notes: settingsUIConfig.ts adds gitlab_event_filter as CredentialComponentType.multiselect with exactly the 6 named options; CredentialFields.tsx renders one checkbox per option.

business_review.criterion: AC3 — UI validation prevents saving a webhook with none of the event types selected
business_review.notes: toggleOption() never calls field.onChange when the resulting token set would be empty; the value can only be mutated through this guarded path, so an empty selection can never reach the form's submitted value.

business_review.criterion: AC5 — No regression for existing webhooks (default to "all events" if no filters are selected)
business_review.notes: undefined/null/'' stored value renders as every checkbox checked, and is never written back unless the user interacts, preserving the backend's existing empty-filter-allows-all semantics.

business_review.criterion: Design constraint — stored format stays a comma-separated string of raw GitLab action tokens (open, close, merge, update, reopen, approved, unapproved), matching the existing backend contract with no schema change
business_review.notes: optionTokens() normalizes the bundled 'approved,unapproved' option into individual tokens before storage; field.onChange always writes next.join(',') as a flat token list.

standards_review.standard: git-workflow.md commit message format (EPMCDME-XXXX: Capital sentence)
standards_review.notes: Commit 312e15330 'EPMCDME-8384: Fix stale validation message and hardcode in MR filter UI' matches the required pattern.

finding_status.notes: SettingsForm.tsx keys both CredentialFields usages by credentialType, forcing a remount (and local-state reset) on every credential-type switch. Verified by a new test that clicks 'Switch away' then 'Switch back' and confirms the stale error message is gone even though the underlying value is unchanged.

emptySelectionError added to CredentialFieldConfig with a generic default; gitlab_event_filter sets it explicitly. Verified by a new test showing an unrelated multiselect field renders the generic message, not GitLab-specific wording.
